text: {"sql": "SELECT reason, stopped_line, COUNT(*) AS pull_count, ROUND(AVG(response_s), 1) AS avg_response_s, SUM(CASE WHEN stopped_line THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS line_stop_count, MIN(ts) AS first_ts, MAX(ts) AS last_ts FROM sf_ops.andon_events WHERE station_id = 'F10' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY reason, stopped_line ORDER BY line_stop_count DESC, pull_count DESC", "columns": ["reason", "stopped_line", "pull_count", "avg_response_s", "line_stop_count", "first_ts", "last_ts"], "purpose": "Summarize F10 andon pulls from Jul-Oct 2026 by reason and line-stop flag to identify which pulls stopped the line"}

data.sql: SELECT reason, stopped_line, COUNT(*) AS pull_count, ROUND(AVG(response_s), 1) AS avg_response_s, SUM(CASE WHEN stopped_line THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS line_stop_count, MIN(ts) AS first_ts, MAX(ts) AS last_ts FROM sf_ops.andon_events WHERE station_id = 'F10' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY reason, stopped_line ORDER BY line_stop_count DESC, pull_count DESC
data.purpose: Summarize F10 andon pulls from Jul-Oct 2026 by reason and line-stop flag to identify which pulls stopped the line
